text:
maria: quick sync — enterprise customer A is pushing hard for 50ms P95 on chat. they said they'll sign if we can hit that for their hotpaths.

devon: thanks. are we discussing infra-level changes or fancier routing? 50ms is tight on current models.

maria: both. sales wants an ask: dedicated hotpath routing + lower-latency model variant (maybe distilled/FP16/8-bit) for priority users. also rollouts and fallbacks.

alex: quick reality check: 50ms P95 end-to-end is only plausible if we: 1) route to small-context optimized model, 2) disable heavy safety/eval hooks sync path, 3) ensure local prefix cache hit rate >70%.

jyoti: +1. perf team measured that for 1k token sequences on A100, distilled-7B gives ~40ms median but P95 ~90ms under load. batching and KV cache reduce tokens but not tail.

samir: propose scoped plan: split-scope -> Hotpath (<=50ms target) for auth'd priority users, Bulk (throughput/cost-optimized) degrade path. Hotpath uses optimized model + dedicated pool; Bulk uses quantized larger model on shared capacity.

maria: that's the idea. need to vet cost impact and launch criteria. can we do a quick RICE? I put a draft below: 

- Reach: 0.12 (12% of traffic flagged as enterprise hotpath) -> ~120k reqs/month
- Impact: 8 (will unlock contract)
- Confidence: 0.6 (estimates + infra unknowns)
- Effort: 5 (3-4 sprints cross-team)

RICE score calc: (Reach * Impact * Confidence) / Effort = (0.12*8*0.6)/5 = 0.1152 -> normalized = 115 (if multiplied by 1000)

devon: seems decent relative to other high-effort infra. but we should break the effort into three deliverables: routing + model variant + rollout/obs.

jyoti: for implementation details: routing changes: policy tag at request-level -> route to dedicated pool. model variant: add distilled-7b-fp16 and 7b-8q fallback. workload: set autoscale min per-customer to avoid cold start tail.

alex: Launch criteria suggestion (must meet all):
- Hotpath P95 <= 55ms under 95th percentile synthetic load (headroom)
- Cache hit rate >= 70% for prefix caching on customer scenarios
- No more than 2x cost increase per hotpath request vs baseline
- Rollout plan with canary at 1% -> 10% -> 100% with automatic rollback on latency regressions

samir: add SEC checklist: KMS keys validated, audit logging enabled, data plane isolation audit pass.

maria: timeline ask from sales: contract in 8 weeks. can we make a minimal MLP (minimum lovable product) in 6 weeks? what is minimum scope?

jyoti: MLP scope: routing + dedicated pool + distilled model in a non-prod region + load test harness + dashboard. No full ops automation. That might be 6 weeks if we drop automatic rollback and manage canaries manually.

devon: risk: manual canary increases ops load during launch. also if we skip automatic rollback, SRE oncall is blocking.

samir: alternative phased approach: Phase 0 (2w): prototype routing + policy flag + perf run. Phase 1 (4w): dedicated pool + distilled model + canary automation. Phase 2 (2w): full rollout + SLA doc + cost optimization.

maria: sales will push for 6 weeks. we can surface Phase 0 as immediate demo to reduce perceived risk.

alex: cost calc quick note: dedicated pool baseline adds ~$12k/mo for reserved capacity, distilled model runtime adds ~0.8x cost per token. With 120k reqs/month that's manageable for their contract value.

jyoti: measurement plan: create synthetic traces from customer recorded prompts (anonymized), run end-to-end SLO harness, export latency percentiles and token counts. store as `slo-run/<customer>/YYYYMMDD`.

devon: obs: require new dashboard tile: per-route P50/P95/P99, cache hit rate, cost per request. tie alerts to 95th crossing for >5 mins.

maria: decision needed: approve Phase 0 + MLP backlog tightened to MLP scope. who owns each piece?

samir: I'll own routing + pool provisioning. jyoti owns model variant onboarding and perf runs. devon/SRE own rollout automation. maria will coordinate sales comms and acceptance.

alex: one more ask: define guardrails for fallback. If hotpath P95 > 70ms for >5m, automatically divert to Bulk variant for that customer (with banner to customer via health API). Implement as policy rule.

maria: noted. ok let's vote. react with :thumbsup: to approve Phase 0 kickoff and MLP scope, :thumbsdown: to reject, :eyes: if need more info.

(devon reacted :thumbsup:)

(jyoti reacted :thumbsup:)

(alex reacted :thumbsup:)

(samir reacted :thumbsup:)

maria: consensus reached. I'll file a ticket and set milestones. thanks team. cc @sales for visibility.

sales: thanks, will update customer timeline with phased delivery and demo after Phase 0.

oncall-bot: Reminder: SRE oncall rotation starts tomorrow for rollout window.

maria: ok locking in owners and next steps in GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/roadmap/issues/321
